instruments.notes: Capped swaps (Hedge Agreements). Fixed Prices range $1.70-$1.78/MMBtu and Maximum Floating Prices range $2.00-$2.20/MMBtu; no single weighted average stated so price fields are null. Company pays counterparty when NYMEX-based Floating Price exceeds Fixed Price up to the Maximum Floating Price, counterparty pays when below. The 20.4 TBtu (stated as TBtu, entered as 20,400,000 MMBtu) is the total Base Quantity for ALL Hedge Agreements as of 1997-01-31, including the $2.48 agreement. The estimated cost to settle all Hedge Agreements was about $13 million (entered as -13 here, covers all agreements). Net settlement payments of about $37 million made in FY ended 1997-01-31.
